evidence.quote: We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB

observations.why: Present-tense 'we're switching' performs the migration as a settled, load-bearing action the speaker expects others to act on — decision-grade.
Flat unhedged assertions presented as justification for the switch — asserted and defensible, but no ratification language; claim-level.
Arrow notation records the migration as a settled, operational fact in a summary header — performed ratification, decision-grade.
Flat performance claim restated as a summary point — asserted, defensible, but no ratification or commitment language beyond the assertion itself.
Timeline stated as a flat fact without hedging or commitment markers — a plain assertion, claim-level.
